name: nomic-monorepo
description: Nomic: a deterministic executable specification language. Rust reference machine in crates/, editor and tooling packages in packages/.

scripts.check: cargo test && pnpm -r run build && pnpm -r run test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && cargo run --release -q -- cite examples/nomic/nomic.nom && node scripts/release.mjs check
scripts.reanchor: node scripts/reanchor.mjs && cargo run --release -q -- cite examples/nomic/nomic.nom --pin
